Our platform covers data management, reconciliation, fund accounting, reporting, and portfolio management. As we scale, we are investing in the reliability, automation, and security of the infrastructure and delivery pipelines that power our platform.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own the design, automation, and reliability of our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support multiple engineering teams and products

* Deploy, operate, and scale containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes
* Build monitoring, logging, and alerting systems that give engineering and support teams real visibility into production health
* Automate configuration management, release processes, and routine operational tasks to reduce manual toil
* Define and enforce security, access control, and secrets management practices across the infrastructure (DevSecOps)
* Continuously improve system reliability, deployment speed, and cost efficiency based on real usage and incidents


**What We Are Looking For**
* 3\-7 years of DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering experience
* Must have hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Strong scripting ability in Python, Bash, or Go for automation
* Hands\-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, Terraform preferred
* Solid understanding of CI/CD tools and practices (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent)
* Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, or Puppet)
* Working knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, or equivalent)
* Solid Linux system administration and networking fundamentals (DNS, load balancing, VPC,firewalls)
* Comfortable working end\-to\-end autonomously, from design to production operations


**Who You Are**
* A builder, energized by improving systems that other teams depend on
* Pragmatic, you pick the right tool, not the flashiest one
* Autonomous, you drive toward outcomes without waiting to be told what to do next
* Detail\-oriented, you take reliability and security seriously


**Why Join**
* Ownership of infrastructure and delivery pipelines that power a global fintech platform
* Direct visibility with engineering leadership on architecture decisions
* Path to growing scope and influence as the initiative matures

Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Quality Engineer Technical Lead, you will be expected to lead the quality engineering strategy for the team with strong ownership of automation, performance validation, test reliability, and production\-quality observability. You will drive and maintain the Automation Suite framework used across the team, define scalable automation practices, strengthen regression and integration coverage, and ensure that quality gates are embedded effectively across delivery pipelines. The role requires strong hands\-on exposure to performance testing, troubleshooting distributed applications in Kubernetes environments, and using observability tools such as Datadog and logging frameworks to diagnose issues, improve system reliability, and support faster root\-cause analysis. Along with individual contribution, you will mentor engineers, guide test design, improve engineering productivity, support customer escalations, and continuously enhance the overall quality posture of the product.
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* The Quality Engineer Technical Lead will be responsible for leading the quality engineering charter for the team, including automation strategy, test framework ownership, performance validation, release quality, and continuous improvement of testing practices.
* Own, maintain, and evolve the Automation Suite framework used by the whole team, ensuring that it is scalable, reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to extend across functional, regression, integration, and API test scenarios.
* Define automation best practices, coding standards, reusable utilities, test data strategies, reporting mechanisms, and execution patterns that improve team productivity and reduce manual validation effort.
* Build and strengthen a robust suite of performance tests covering key product workflows, scalability scenarios, load profiles, reliability checks, and performance regression detection.
* Work closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to embed quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and ensure that automation, regression, and performance feedback is available early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Provide strong troubleshooting support for issues observed in Kubernetes\-based deployments, including pod failures, service connectivity, resource constraints, configuration issues, and environment\-related problems.
* Use observability platforms such as Datadog, application logs, metrics, dashboards, traces, and logging frameworks to perform root\-cause analysis and support faster resolution of production and pre\-production issues.
* Mentor quality engineers and developers on automation design, testability, performance analysis, defect investigation, and engineering practices that improve overall product quality.
* Support customer escalations by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and telemetry, validating fixes, and ensuring relevant automated coverage is added to prevent recurrence.
* Drive continuous improvements in automation reliability, execution speed, test coverage, performance benchmarking, observability, and quality engineering processes.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 7\+ years of experience in quality engineering, test automation, performance testing, and technical leadership.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing, developing, maintaining, and scaling automation frameworks for API, UI, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end test coverage.
* Proven ability to lead an Automation Suite framework for a team or program, including framework architecture, reusable components, test orchestration, reporting, maintainability, and adoption by multiple engineers.
* Good programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language used for automation development, test utilities, scripting, and framework enhancements.
* Strong experience with performance testing tools and practices, including load testing, scalability testing, baseline creation, bottleneck identification, trend analysis, and performance regression validation.
* Good troubleshooting exposure in Kubernetes\-based environments, including deployments, pods, services, ingress, configuration, resource utilization, logs, and common runtime issues.
* Hands\-on exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, with the ability to analyze dashboards, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health indicators.
* Strong understanding of logging frameworks and log analysis practices to support debugging, defect triaging, root\-cause analysis, and production issue investigation.
* Experience integrating automation suites with CI/CD pipelines and ensuring automated quality gates are reliable, actionable, and aligned with release expectations.
* Exposure to cloud\-native applications, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed system behavior will be an important factor.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect automation failures, performance trends, logs, metrics, and deployment behavior to identify issues quickly and accurately.
* Ability to mentor team members, review automation code, improve test design, promote quality ownership, and collaborate effectively with engineering, DevOps, and product stakeholders.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

description:

 We are currently seeking a Systems Administration Senior Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid\-level role involves independently managing end\-to\-end endpoint lifecycle operations — OS deployment, patch management, application delivery, and device compliance — for large global enterprise clients. The engineer will handle complex L2/L3 incidents, contribute to platform improvements, and serve as a reliable technical contributor within NTT DATA's EPM managed services practice supporting clients across US, APAC, and EMEA geographies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 OS Deployment \& Image Management
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe\-and\-reload, and in\-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune\-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.


 Patch Management
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end patch management operations for SCCM\-managed and Intune\-managed endpoints across client accounts.
* Configure and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for monthly Microsoft Patch Tuesday cycles.
* Manage Windows Update for Business (WUfB) rings, feature update policies, and quality update deferrals in Intune.
* Perform patch impact analysis, rollback planning, and emergency patching for zero\-day vulnerabilities.
* Generate and present patch compliance dashboards and exception reports to delivery leads and client stakeholders.
* Coordinate with security teams to address Qualys/vulnerability scan findings within SLA timelines.


 Application \& Software Management
   

  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.


 Infrastructure \& Platform Management
   

  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.


**Required Skills**
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, patch management, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co\-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client\-facing delivery and documentation
